risks.risk: The heating element may be burnt out or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the iron plugged in and the indicator light turning on, or a photo of the soleplate glowing red.

risks.risk: The steam function may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the iron producing steam.

risks.risk: The soleplate may be damaged or have rust underneath the visible surface.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the entire soleplate surface.

proof_requests: Close-up of the rating plate on the iron (usually on the heel or handle).
A clear photo of the soleplate surface to check for rust or deep scratches.
A video of the iron plugged in and heating up.
A photo of the steam vent area to check for clogging.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
